choice_before_access: All original/soft-compressed weights frozen and preserved. No selecting one seed or weaker SoftGNN. No new baseline families. This is matched version selection and engineering ablation,not an independent confirmation.
scope: 128fresh serial runs on ALL8already exposed GRID52dates. Old2/new2seeds are configuration comparison;three main baseline families remain FULL/PPO/SoftGNN2seeds. No new dates,training,teachers,models,thresholds or outcome-based filtering.
timing: Rotate/reverse8implementations over8datefamilies/two timing repeats. One fresh single-thread worker each. All original DC/safeQP caches/controller/legal masks/GRID28faststop unchanged. Equivalent static-prior cache applied to ALL original-prior users,including old/new/PPO. Lazy first build/fresh-field validation paid in online control;setup/physical/export separate.
primary: Report completion and steps for every family/seed. Require no earlier failure than FULL. Operating cost primary only on FULL-completed weeks when our method also completes; average normalized cost within family,not total across unequal survival. Speed primary on equal-horizon pairs only: mean paired control-time reduction over date families,repeat averaged,own seeds both reported and equally averaged.
secondary: Pooled equal-horizon control time; topology source time/queries; per-family p95 decision latency; reported training/teacher costs and graph attribution limits. No causal allocation of shared cache savings to GNN.
investment_screen: For both own seeds: no earlier failure on all8families; comparable complete-week cost<=0.5%ofFULL per family; mean equal-horizon control reduction>=5%,positive in>=ceil(0.75*n_comparable)families. This is practical screening,not equivalence or acceptance guarantee. Other/mixed outcomes remain visible; no test-based model retuning or family replacement.
statistics: Fixed10000 date-family bootstrap resamples,seed20261011; same estimator as GRID44. Average two timing repeats and report both model seeds plus their equal-weight family average. Runs are not independent grids.
sealed_use: GRID52dates already exposed;not called sealed/unseen again. They remain excluded from training/tuning. Historical GRID44/51/52results are immutable.
baseline_note: SoftGNN official GAT/converter unchanged but IDF2023/909actions/basecontext/148states/64epochs is a resource-matched adaptation,not original WCCI2022 full-paper reproduction. Recent-method success/failure cannot refute published results.
model_status: Candidate qualified on old development only; this confirmation cannot be used to choose the better seed. All outcomes retained. No automatic default-model change.
version_selection: Apply same original quality/survival/time investment screen to EACH version/BOTH seeds,relativeFULL. If only one version meets it,prefer that version as the engineering candidate. If both meet it,require>=2%seed-average paired control improvement,>=6/8positive families,and BOTHmatched seed mean directions positive to prefer faster version. Symmetric rule for old. Otherwise retain both/no clear preferred version;report quality-time frontier,do not tune new parameters or pick a seed. Screening is not significance,equivalence or paper acceptance.
